4865.title: Skill directory publication rejects modeled access-denied renames
4865.rootCauseOneLine: Both skill publication writers make one rename attempt and propagate EPERM after deleting the candidate, including when a complete destination exists.

prReviews.verdict: Static review only — does not cover modeled access-denied publication
prReviews.topFinding: The collision catch still recognizes only EEXIST/ENOTEMPTY and the catalog writer is unchanged. No PR code was executed.

4865.proposedFix: First validate the native Windows lock and collision cases, then add bounded Windows-specific publication retries and validate concurrent destinations in both writers.
4865.caveats: Only application-side EPERM handling was reproduced by filesystem fault injection on Linux, twice at trusted main. Windows, Defender, native error mappings, real turn.submit, and locked cleanup remain unverified. No fix PR.
